name: Ecommerce-website-final
description: Full-stack fashion e-commerce app with React 19, TypeScript, Express, MariaDB, Docker, secure JWT auth, Stripe Checkout, and an AI-powered catalog assistant.

paragraphs: D Fashion is a full-stack fashion e-commerce application built as a production-style learning project. It provides a responsive storefront for browsing products, managing a cart, completing checkout, and reviewing orders. It also includes authentication and administration features for managing products, customers, and orders.

The project is intentionally split into a React/TypeScript frontend and a Node.js/Express backend. The backend can run as a conventional local server or as a Netlify Function for deployment. Product, user, order, and upload data currently use JSON-file storage, which keeps the project easy to run locally but is not yet suitable for durable production storage.
features: Responsive home, shop, product, checkout, login, registration, favorites, account, and administration pages.
Product catalog filtering by category, brand, price, size, and color.
Product search, sorting, grid/list layout controls, and product image galleries.
Selectable product options such as size and color.
Shopping cart quantity controls, totals, delivery costs, and promotional discounts.
